question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**survive**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** word to fill the blank is '**survive**'.
 
• The word '**survive**' means '**continue to live or exist, especially in spite of danger or hardship**'.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate answer is '**survive**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Prevail**- prove more powerful or superior.
 
• **Exist**- live, especially under adverse conditions.
 
• **Bear**- carry the weight of; support, endure.
